reason: A proposes the more physically grounded intervention: Al-promoted coherent γ′ precipitation is established in Ni–Ti-containing multicomponent matrices and is plausibly stable over the stated 700–1000 °C regime, with direct microstructural and mechanical falsification tests. B lacks evidence that ~5 at% Mo will produce beneficial fine precipitates, confounds Mo addition with aging, and tests above the aging temperature—up to 1600 °C—where precipitate dissolution and even matrix instability are likely.
